transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, hi. I guess I'm just having some trouble with work lately. I teach high school, and... well, I'll sit down with a stack of essays or a curriculum document, fully intending to get through it. But then... maybe ten minutes later, I realize I’ve just been staring at the exact same page. My mind is on three other things, and I'm barely taking in what’s right in front of me. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, like teaching or other activities?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I feel hopeless or anything like that. I still like my job. It's just... what I said before.
Do you find yourself feeling overly worried or anxious about a number of things, like work responsibilities, family, or other aspects of life, even when there isn’t a clear reason to be?
No. Not really. I mean, I don't think I worry more than anyone else. Just normal stuff, I guess.
Do you find it difficult to stay focused on tasks even when they’re not work-related, like reading a book or watching a movie, or is this mainly happening with your teaching duties?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed, to be honest. I don't read a whole lot for fun right now anyway, so... I guess it's mostly just with the work stuff.
Outside of work, do you ever find it hard to focus on things like conversations, chores, or other daily activities?

I don't know. I guess I haven't really thought about it. Conversations are usually fine, I think. Chores just... get done eventually. I don't really pay attention to how long it takes or if I'm focused.
Outside of work, do you ever find it hard to focus on things like conversations, chores, or other daily activities?
I mean... like I just said, I haven't really noticed. Um. When I'm at home, it's just normal life. I don't really track how focused I am on taking out the trash or whatever. It's just stuff you do.
Outside of work, do you ever notice yourself losing track of time or getting easily distracted during routine tasks, like cooking, driving, or even brushing your teeth?

Um, no. Not really. I just... I get in the car and drive. It's fine. Cooking is just making dinner, you know? I don't think I'm losing track of time doing that stuff. I just haven't really noticed any problems with normal day-to-day things.
When you're at home, do you ever catch yourself forgetting why you walked into a room, or losing track of what you were doing in the middle of a task, even briefly?

I don't think so. I mean... maybe occasionally? Doesn't everyone do that sometimes? But no, not really. It's not something I notice happening a lot. Like I said, I'm just doing normal stuff at home, I don't really pay attention to it.
Outside of work, do you find yourself getting easily distracted by things around you, even when you're trying to focus on something, like a chore or a conversation?
No. I don't think so. I just... I do what needs to be done. If I'm talking to someone, I'm talking to them. I'm not really looking around for other things to focus on. It's just... normal.

Outside of work, do you ever find yourself struggling to organize tasks or keep track of responsibilities, like forgetting appointments, missing deadlines, or misplacing everyday items more often than usual?

I suppose... yeah. I do forget things sometimes. Probably more than I want to admit. 

Just ordinary stuff, mostly. Like... paying a bill before a late notice shows up. Or if my wife asks me to pick something up on the way home, I might forget. Sometimes replying to a parent email, stuff like that. But... yeah. Just normal responsibilities, I guess.
Outside of work, do you ever have trouble starting tasks, even small ones, or do you often procrastinate on things until the last minute?
Not really. I mean... if something needs to get done, I just do it. I don't really sit around waiting to start. It's just... regular life. You just handle it.
Outside of work, do you ever find yourself losing things like your keys, phone, or wallet often, or do you have trouble keeping track of your belongings more than others seem to?

Yeah... I guess I do. I spend a lot of time hunting for things I need for the day. Just... my classroom keys, or a USB drive. Lesson notes. Even stuff for refereeing, like my whistle and cards. 

I don't really know why, it's just... I'll be absolutely sure I had them in my hand five minutes earlier, and then they're gone. So... yeah. I lose things.

Do you remember having similar issues with focus or forgetfulness going back to your childhood or adolescence, like trouble paying attention in class, finishing assignments, or keeping track of your things?

I suppose so, yeah. Um... even back in primary school, I guess. 

My parents were always finding... just crumpled up worksheets at the bottom of my backpack. Things I forgot to turn in. And my old report cards... they usually said stuff like, "bright but careless." Or that I wouldn't finish my work unless I was being closely supervised. 

So... yeah. It's been around for a while.
